title: New nanofiber glaucoma drainage implant: Effectiveness, safety, first in vivo results, and optimization of surgical technique

license.statement: CC BY 4.0 (article <license>: Creative Commons Attribution License, PLOS)

indication: normal (normotensive, no induced glaucoma) eyes of New Zealand White rabbits; novel electrospun PVDF nanofiber glaucoma drainage implant inserted through a scleral tunnel into the anterior chamber with its distal part under the conjunctiva; one operated eye per animal, contralateral eye unoperated

groups.description: Operated eyes with the new nanofiber drainage implant (Table 2 column 'Study group'); analysed over 13 eyes after excluding the animal whose implant extruded

decision: no admissible series; no record written

exclusions.what: Table 2 (pone.0335858.t002) column 2 'Study group IOP', operated eyes, cells R2C2..R7C2
exclusions.reason: analysis set selected by a postoperative outcome: the animal whose implant extruded eleven days after surgery was excluded from the statistical analyses (Results), so the means cover only eyes free of that outcome (protocol 1.0.0, inclusion rule 4)
unoperated contralateral (fellow) eyes are not admissible

exclusions.what: Table 3 (pone.0335858.t003) histology and Table 1 (pone.0335858.t001) electrospinning conditions
IOP means with SD and n given in the Abstract and Results text
exclusions.reason: same outcome-selected analysis set as Table 2; not table cells

notes: Tonometer: Tono-Pen AVIA under topical anaesthesia (Methods); reference measured before general anaesthesia, untreated normotensive eyes.
Table 2 column 2 uses comma decimal separators, which the cell reader would not parse as decimals; irrelevant here because the column is excluded.
The article states that all data are available at the Open Science Framework (DOI 10.17605/OSF.IO/B9QM6); that dataset was not acquired or used.
Procedure context recorded as 'other' (novel bleb-forming nanofiber drainage implant); the triage note suggested 'tube'.
